sources.title: Qwen3.8-9B: Running the Community-Distilled Model Locally
sources.snippet: What is Qwen3.8-9B? Qwen3.8-9B is an unofficial, community-built distillation of Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 model, released by a team called Empero. Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 lands at 27 billion parameters (with reports of a much larger internal teacher configuration), which puts it out of reach for anyone without a serious GPU budget. sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. Latest: Qwen3.8 distilled to 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B Ridge GGUF at 11.7 GiB. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face.
